# HtmlViewStatus <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HtmlViewStatus:Int32 htmlview:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htmlview` | In | Int32 | required | The handle from [CreateHtmlView](CreateHtmlView). |

**Returns:** 0 for loaded and 1 for loading. Always 0 here, as no page is loaded.

## Description

Tells whether the page is still loading: 0 for loaded and 1 for loading.

## Differences

* Always 0, as no page is ever loaded or loading.
